phases.name: Pre-development and evidence
phases.scope: Evidence-based product, provider, market, security, UX and stack research; synthetic feasibility.
exit_criteria: Primary-source research has checked dates, confidence and limits
MVP boundaries, threat model, data model, UX states and stack ADR agree
Synthetic feasibility and automated checks pass
P0 task coverage and handoff are validated

phases.name: Repository foundation and DevOps
phases.scope: Web/API, identity, authorization, persistence, audit, workers, install and CI.
exit_criteria: Fresh install and repeatable builds pass in GitHub Actions
Two authenticated tenants prove API, worker and search isolation
PostgreSQL, queue, recovery and revocation cases pass
Authenticated health and commit-specific evidence are recorded

phases.name: Provider connectivity and inventory
phases.scope: Capability SDK, cPanel/WHM, IMAP/SMTP, catalog, inventory and permissions.
exit_criteria: Each provider exposes exact capabilities and permissions per operation
Connection inventory is distinct from content consent
Fault, revocation, throttle and malformed-response fixtures pass
Live and simulated evidence are distinguished

phases.name: Mail synchronization and inbox
phases.scope: Gmail, Graph, IMAP sync, normalized messages, inbox, search and safe outbound.
exit_criteria: Initial/incremental sync, replay, cursor expiry and restart recovery pass
Tenant/mailbox grants apply to sync, storage, search and attachments
Lost send receipt remains UNKNOWN until reconciliation
Live and simulated provider evidence are distinguished

phases.name: Provider administration
phases.scope: Mailbox lifecycle, directory operations, cPanel/WHM, delegation and bulk actions.
exit_criteria: Every operation exposes exact capability, permission and target
Destructive actions require approval and idempotent receipts
Provider state is reconciled; API acceptance is not final erasure
Bulk partial failure, rate-limit and cancellation recovery pass

phases.name: DNS and infrastructure observability
phases.scope: Source-grounded DNS and infrastructure observations with provenance.
exit_criteria: Every value has source, observation time, confidence and freshness
Simulated values and stale/missing observations are labeled
Read probes cannot trigger DNS cutover or destructive change

phases.name: Migration and backup
phases.scope: Migration preflight, resumable manifests, backup, restore and verification.
exit_criteria: Synthetic transfer/restore verifies counts, hashes and checkpoints
Partial failure resumes without silent data loss or duplicate work
Live transfer evidence is separate from synthetic proof

phases.name: Incident response and safe automation
phases.scope: Evidence-linked incidents, approved actions, policy and rollback.
exit_criteria: Incident evidence is traceable to source and authorized actor
Multi-client simulated incidents exercise approval and rollback
No action exceeds policy or blindly retries uncertain mutation

phases.name: AI assistance and privacy
phases.scope: Privacy-governed AI gateway, redaction, evaluation and injection defenses.
exit_criteria: Only approved minimized/redacted content reaches models
Red-team rejects cross-tenant retrieval and unauthorized sending
Outputs cite evidence and remain advisory absent approval

phases.name: Web release and self-hosting
phases.scope: Install, upgrade, backup/restore, hardening, artifacts and operations.
exit_criteria: Fresh install, upgrade, backup and restore pass on supported target
Security findings, SBOM and artifact hashes are recorded
Rollback/recovery is exercised; no unsupported readiness claim

phases.name: Desktop clients
phases.scope: Secure desktop clients after web/API gate.
exit_criteria: Supported OS builds/install/upgrade/uninstall have repeatable evidence
Credential storage and offline behavior pass security checks
Real signed artifact exists before release claim

phases.name: Mobile clients
phases.scope: Android/iOS after mobile design and API gates.
exit_criteria: Device/emulator tests cover isolation, expiry and offline behavior
Secure storage and notification privacy are verified
Build/signing status is evidenced without store-deployment claim

phases.name: Enterprise integration
phases.scope: Enterprise policy and separate hosting platform via scoped API.
exit_criteria: Independent operation works without shared DB or raw credentials
Versioned contract enforces tenant, audience, expiry and revocation
Enterprise and cross-product credential isolation tests pass
